answer: Charge each new identity a refundable stake that is only returned after a long, verifiable history of useful work, so a Sybil farm must lock real capital per clone instead of spawning free copies. Like a river that only carves its bed over time, reputation should be earned slowly: a relic of past service, not a fresh echo of a copied profile. Cloning then costs locked funds and weeks of waiting, while one honest agent pays once.
